reasoning_content: The base login messages are probably in the `themes/src/main/resources/theme/base/messages/` directory. Let's grab messages.properties and messages_de.properties from there.

action.command:
cd /tmp/kc-msg
for f in messages messages_de; do
  curl -fsSL "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/keycloak/keycloak/26.1.2/themes/src/main/resources/theme/base/messages/$f.properties" -o "$f.properties" && echo "OK $f" || echo "FAIL $f"
done
echo "=== en ==="; grep -iE "specialchar|invalidPasswordLength|lowerCase|upperCase|digit" messages.properties 2>/dev/null | head -12
echo "=== de ==="; grep -iE "specialchar|invalidPasswordLength|lowerCase|upperCase|digit" messages_de.properties 2>/dev/null | head -12
